names.note: The calendar’s own name page for him is «Николай (Ковалев), иерей, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Николая пресвитера». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The year the day line closes with, «(1937)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Николая пресвитера (1937).»

attestations.note: The day’s third and last entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind it. The line says «пресвитера» and the name page «иерей», priest, which agree, so `presbyter` and the office `Priest` are both the source’s own words. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar’s twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries, and THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. No folder held him: a Cyrillic grep for «Ковалев» over every `saint.json` returns only `andrew-kovalev`, a different forename. The day page prints one kontakion and it is not under his name.
